section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 14, Lövstabruk-Västland
section.notes: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 19.5 km. Visit Roslagen/Vikingaleden gives about 19.4 km. Downloaded Naturkartan GPX computes to about 19.65 km including all segments/spurs.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 14 GPX as primary geometry.
The GPX direction matches official prose: Lövstabruk-to-Västland.
Preserve the official multi-segment geometry. Segments include the main route, a near-zero connector/artifact near Svenbo, and the short Västland/Tämnarån shelter spur.
Do not flatten all segments into one forced line during integration.
qa: Downloaded GPX has 501 points across five segments/tracks and no >500 m internal steps.
Etapp 13 written end to Etapp 14 start is 0 m; Etapp 14 end to Etapp 15 start is about 1.5 m.
The Västland shelter is on an official short spur/detour near Tämnarån and should remain linked to the section but not treated as the main endpoint itself.

importRows.name: Toalett, Lövstabruk
importRows.notes: Tourist toilet in the old fälängan. Listed as open 24h May-October with variation. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 13; dedupe by source URL/coordinate.

importRows.name: Vatten, Lövstabruk
importRows.notes: Drinking water at the Lövstabruk toilet/fälängan service point, available May-October with opening variation. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 13.

importRows.name: Toalett, Österlövsta kyrka
importRows.notes: Public toilet in a red building outside the church wall, signed from Upplandsleden. Listed as open year-round but may close for winter repair/renovation.

importRows.name: Vatten, Österlövsta kyrka
importRows.notes: Drinking-water refill at the signed toilet by Österlövsta kyrka. Listed as year-round but may close for repair/renovation in winter.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Svenbo
importRows.notes: Shelter/rest area in the forest, about 12 km from Lövstabruk. Ground around the shelter is uneven, but smaller tents may fit nearby; keep tenting pending rather than importing a formal campsite.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Svenbo
importRows.notes: Simple fireplace at Svenbo shelter/rest area. Current Naturkartan notice says there is no firewood at Svenbo, so hikers should not rely on supplied wood.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Svenbo
importRows.notes: Rest area in the forest at Svenbo, same physical cluster as the shelter and fireplace.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Västland
importRows.notes: Shelter by Tämnarån near Hembygdsgården. It is a short signed detour/spur from Upplandsleden and is shared endpoint context with Etapp 15.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Västland
importRows.notes: Fireplace at the Västland shelter/rest area by Tämnarån. Apply current fire-ban and grass/forest fire-risk guidance.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Västland
importRows.notes: Rest area at the Västland shelter beside Tämnarån, reached by the signed spur near Hembygdsgården.

importRows.name: Vatten, Västlands kyrka
importRows.notes: Tap by the parish house at Västlands kyrka, to the right of the smaller entrance. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 15.

importRows.name: Toalett, Västlands kyrka
importRows.notes: Public toilet on the cemetery/church grounds, signed from the trail. Listed as year-round but may close for winter repair/renovation. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 15.

importRows.name: Lövstabruk bruksmiljö
importRows.notes: Historic ironworks/manor environment at the stage start. Shared endpoint POI with Etapp 13; keep one heritage POI rather than separate rows for each visitor attraction.

importRows.name: Österlövsta kyrka
importRows.notes: Church environment by Strömarån. Tierp municipality describes the Österlövsta church setting as a major church environment, with the present church originating in 1451 and older church/cemetery remains nearby.

importRows.name: Barsjön och gammeltallarna
importRows.notes: Route-feature POI for the small forest lake Barsjön and old pines on its west side, described in official route prose. Coordinate is snapped to GPX near the lake and should be refined if a discrete marker is found.

pending.name: Möjlig tältplats nära Svenbo
pending.reason: Naturkartan notes uneven ground around the Svenbo shelter but says smaller tents can be pitched nearby if you look around. Marker categories are shelter/fireplace/rest area, not a formal campsite.

pending.name: Knuters bytomt
pending.reason: Official route prose says the trail soon passes remains of Knuters, demolished in the 1940s, with wells, cellars and fruit trees. Coordinate is inferred from the first few kilometres of GPX and lacks a separate marker/source.

suppressions.name: Parkering, norra Lövstabruk
suppressions.notes: Barnens Bruk/north Lövstabruk parking on private land for day visitors/passenger cars. Access metadata only; no camping/overnight implication.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Lövstabruk Herrgården
suppressions.notes: Start transit metadata only. Shared with Etapp 13.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Västland
suppressions.notes: A few parking spaces at Västlands kyrka. Access metadata only and shared with Etapp 15.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Västlands kyrka
suppressions.notes: Endpoint transit metadata only. Shared with Etapp 15.

suppressions.name: No supplied firewood at Svenbo
suppressions.notes: Naturkartan current notice says there is currently no firewood at Svenbo, published December 2025. Attach as caveat to the fireplace/shelter rather than a normal facility row.

suppressions.name: Fire-risk and fire-ban context
suppressions.notes: Current fire-risk/fire-ban guidance should be checked before using fireplaces. This is general planning context, not a section-specific closure.

suppressions.name: Strömarån timber-floating context
suppressions.notes: Official prose says timber used to be floated in Strömarån before Österlövsta. Keep as narrative context unless a discrete route-feature marker is added.

suppressions.name: Tämnarån canoe/river context
suppressions.notes: Tämnarån canoe-route and river recreation notes are useful context near Västland, but the hiking importable facilities are already represented by the Västland shelter/fireplace/rest area.

suppressions.name: Lövstabruk seasonal visitor services
suppressions.notes: Official route prose says summer inn/accommodation exists in Lövstabruk. Keep as town context unless the app later maintains seasonal commercial food/lodging rows with opening data.

suppressions.name: Etapp 13 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 13-specific rows except shared Lövstabruk endpoint services/access. Do not import Risön, Finnsjön, Nybron, Södra Bruksdammen or Etapp 13-specific context into Etapp 14.

suppressions.name: Etapp 15 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 15-specific rows except shared Västland endpoint services/access. Do not import Honolulukojan, Tingshällarna, Trusksjön, Marma or Dalälven shelter rows into Etapp 14.

decisions.dedupePolicy: Dedupe Lövstabruk endpoint services/access with Etapp 13 and Västland endpoint services/access with Etapp 15. Keep transport/parking rows metadata-only. Treat the Västland shelter as an official short spur service, not the main endpoint coordinate.

iterationLog.focus: First batch pass for Etapp 14 using official Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen pages, GPX checks, Naturkartan object pages, Visit Roslagen/Vikingaleden, municipal/church/fire-risk support and leakage review.
iterationLog.result: Created standalone Etapp 14 research file. Normal imports cover Lövstabruk toilet/water, Österlövsta kyrka toilet/water and heritage, Svenbo shelter/fire/rest, Västland shelter/fire/rest, Västlands kyrka water/toilet, Lövstabruk heritage and Barsjön route context. Svenbo tenting and Knuters remain pending; access rows, fire-risk/no-firewood context, Tämnarån/Strömarån context, commercial Lövstabruk services and Etapp 13/15 leakage are metadata-only or suppressed.

iterationLog.summary: Quality pass for Etapp 14: rechecked JSON structure, source references, GPX/mapdata drawability, declared counts and unsupported type risk against the full numbered Upplandsleden set.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Primary evidence remains the official Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen route material already cited in this file; no new row was promoted solely from unsourced inference.
nextIterationNeeds: Replace any GPX-snapped coordinates named in validation limitations with exact Naturkartan/object or municipal coordinates.
Re-check seasonal/commercial/pending services before final import.

iterationLog.summary: Integration/dedupe pass for Etapp 14: compared rows against adjacent and same-coordinate etapper to flag shared endpoints, repeated access metadata and route/loop leakage for later import consolidation.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Rows remain section-scoped for traceability; actual app import should use the separate dedupe registry generated in this pass to collapse canonical shared facilities.

iterationLog.summary: Reviewed existing deep-source coverage for Etapp 14; retained object-confirmed high-confidence rows and kept 2 pending/context rows out of normal import.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Object-level Naturkartan/official sources were preferred; rows without strong current import evidence remain pending or medium-confidence where appropriate.
nextIterationNeeds: Use dedupe registry during app integration to collapse shared endpoint facilities.

iterationLog.summary: Final quality pass for Etapp 14: checked source keys, import/pending/suppression counts, decision coverage, adjacent-section duplicates and mapdata drawability.
iterationLog.sourceReview: The section is now at the same integration-readiness standard as the strengthened Etapp 1-9 set, with remaining caveats carried explicitly in validation limitations.
nextIterationNeeds: No further section-level enrichment needed before integration beyond global dedupe/import policy.

validation.transportMetadataPolicy: Rows in decisions.transportMetadataOnly are retained in suppressions with metadataRole access_transport_metadata; they are planning/deduplication records and should not become normal facility imports unless the integration policy changes.
validation.mapCanDrawCondition: Draw/use the official Naturkartan Etapp 14 GPX as a five-segment geometry. Preserve the short Västland/Tämnarån shelter spur and do not flatten the geometry into one forced line.
validation.previewNotGenerated: Standalone research file only; import preview will be generated during later integration.
checks: Iteration 2 quality pass: source keys, declared counts, supported import types, decision coverage and mapdata drawability revalidated across all numbered Upplandsleden etapper.
Iteration 3 integration pass: cross-etapp coordinate/name clusters audited and duplicate-prone shared endpoint rows classified for later import dedupe.
Iteration 4 deepening pass: object-level sources, coordinates and section relevance rechecked against official/Naturkartan material.
Iteration 5 final pass: dedupe-aware integration readiness, source coverage, counts and decision buckets revalidated.
limitations: 1 import row(s) intentionally remain medium-confidence because exact/current object evidence is weaker or the item is contextual rather than an ordinary facility.
